newsitem.title: GREECE: FORMER OTE MANAGER SUES DELTA SECURITIES FOR FRAUD.
newsitem.headline: FORMER OTE MANAGER SUES DELTA SECURITIES FOR FRAUD.

text.p: Ioannis Georgakas, a former OTE telecom manager in Lamia, has sued Delta Securities president Dimitris Argyriadis and two other company representatives for fraud, court sources said.
Georgakas claims that Costas Karamanos and Ioannis Nikolikakis, Delta Securities representatives, told him in 1994 the firm offered high return money management services.
Georgakas gave them 20 million drachmas for investment but says in his suit he only got back seven million.
Delta Securities has been charged with fraud in last year's scandal that shut down the bourse for four days. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
